raw_callback.review_note:
Independent Claude Sonnet 5 review 2026-10-12. Hashes match frozen values exactly (writer-v2 ac6a9e68..., sources-v2 0bc24005...). Blind solve of candidate-public-v2.json BEFORE reading keys, via primary-source research: cinema-021=Mastroianni/Rubini (La Dolce Vita), cinema-022=MacLaine/Kubelik (The Apartment), music-021=Rosetta Tharpe (Gospel Train), music-022=Big Mama Thornton (Hound Dog 1953 original). All 4 match writer-v2.json keys. No duplicates found: rg scan of quizzes/+next/content for RU+EN name/title variants gave zero hits except 'Ширли Маклейн' as an unrelated distractor in prep_film_actors_2.json (Tiffany's/Holly Golightly) - confirms sources-v2.md's own finding, not new. V1's 2 cinema duplicates (Sunset Blvd/Norma Desmond, Conversation/Harry Caul) confirmed replaced; V1's guitarist-cue and session-date issues confirmed fixed in V2.

Live-verified primary sources: AFI catalog page fully confirms cinema-022 (cast, written-for-Lemmon, Brief Encounter inspiration, NY/LA shoot, forced perspective). BFI pages confirm cinema-021 (cast, Rubini name, paparazzi origin, Trevi, Via Veneto studio build, Christ-statue opening). Smithsonian Folkways PDF (opened via Read, not WebFetch which returned binary) confirms music-022: Thornton's own words date Hound Dog to 1953, Leiber/Stoller/Johnny Otis/Peacock, and the 1966 Muddy Waters band credits. All directly_supported.

Could NOT verify: catalog.rockhall.com (music-021's cited catalog source) returned 403 on every attempt (WebFetch + archive.org) - cannot confirm author's 'opened successfully' claim; recording as unavailable, not invented.

FACTUAL CONCERN, reason for rework (error_count=1): music-021 premise 'альбом Gospel Train, изданный Mercury Wing в 1956 году' is likely inaccurate. English Wikipedia's Gospel Train (album) article gives the original 1956 release as plain Mercury Records MG-20201, no Wing. Wing Records only became Mercury's budget LP-reissue imprint from August 1958 (per Wing Records history); a Wing pressing (MGW-12235) is almost certainly a later reissue, not the 1956 original. Could not open Rock Hall's catalog page to see if the error originates there. Recommend citing 'Mercury' for the 1956 original, or correcting the year if Wing is kept, with a source that isn't 403'd.

Editorial note, not counted as error: cinema-021's character 'Марчелло Рубини' shares its first name with correct actor 'Марчелло Мастроянни' - real Fellini-intentional fact, but lets a player pattern-match without film knowledge; worth noting for future items.
